task.title: P6-059: Fix migrate.sh reporting up to date after a run that embedded and applied nothing
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 2 — Ship gates). Original id: P6-059. Size: S. Specs: specs/delivery-pipeline.md, specs/data-model.md.

**`scripts/migrate.sh` can report `migrations: up to date` on a run that embedded and applied nothing — the one manual step gating a prod schema deploy.** Verified 2026-07-28 (`specs/phase-6-probes/P6-059.md`, CONFIRMED, with a root cause the original report lacked). It is not a flaky race: **cargo has no dependency edge on `migrations/` at all.** sqlx 0.8.6 emits `include_str!` per *existing* file only, its directory tracking (`proc_macro::tracked_path`) is behind `sqlx_macros_unstable`/`procmacro2_semver_exempt` (neither set here), and `app/` has no build script — so adding a `.sql` file cannot invalidate the `app` fingerprint, and the `touch app/src/db.rs` at `scripts/migrate.sh:73-80` is an mtime bet, not a guarantee. Independently, `server/src/main.rs:21-31` prints the success string on any `Ok(())` and `MIGRATOR.run` discards what it applied, so nothing can tell a real run from a no-op. There is no DB-side verification anywhere. Stake is larger than filed: `specs/app-ui.md:1391-1402` records that migration 0009 is **not** expand-first for new code, so an unmigrated prod 502s on every write while reads stay green — a partial outage that looks healthy.

**Both fixes are required — they close different holes:**

1. **Deterministic embed.** Add `app/build.rs` with `println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed=../migrations");` (relative to `CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR`, which is what `sqlx::migrate!("../migrations")` resolves against), then delete the `touch` from `scripts/migrate.sh:73-78`. **It must be unconditional and side-effect-free:** build scripts compile for and run on the *host* for every target, so this one runs during the hosted, native (incl. the Android NDK cross-build) and `wasm32` hydrate builds alike — nothing in it may touch sqlx, the DB or `DATABASE_URL`, which CI deliberately does not have. Costs one host-compiled unit per target build and a one-time CI rust-cache fingerprint churn. Confirm at implementation time whether cargo's directory scan also catches *edits* to existing files; the append-only new-file case is the one that is broken today and is caught.

2. **Verify against the database, not the binary.** Read the applied set back — `Migrate::list_applied_migrations` (a trait method on a `PgConnection`, not on the pool, so this needs a connection and the trait import) compared against `MIGRATOR.iter()`. `app/src/db.rs:41-56` returns the applied/embedded versions instead of `()`; `server/src/main.rs:21-31` prints those versions instead of the fixed string. **This is the fix that removes the failure mode** — (1) alone makes the embed race unlikely but leaves a silent success for every *other* no-op cause (wrong branch URL, stale cross-target binary, aborted `cargo run`).

**Acceptance:** a migrate run distinguishes "applied 0010" from "0010 already present" from "0010 not embedded", and cannot print success having applied nothing. Also correct the now-false "guarantee[s] a re-embed" sentence at `specs/data-model.md:555-559`. `--quiet` at `scripts/migrate.sh:80` is cargo's, not the binary's, so the version log prints through it — dropping it is optional once (2) lands.
